name: Discourse
description: Modern discussion forum and mailing list platform with categories, tagging and moderation tools.

envVars.description: Public hostname the instance is served from

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DISCOURSE_DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      DISCOURSE_DB_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      DISCOURSE_REDIS_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-redis"
      DISCOURSE_HOSTNAME: {{env.DISCOURSE_HOSTNAME}}
      DISCOURSE_SECRET_KEY_BASE: {{env.DISCOURSE_SECRET_KEY_BASE}}
      DISCOURSE_SMTP_PASSWORD: {{env.DISCOURSE_SMTP_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/shared
      - {{appDataPath}}/logs:/var/log
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: discourse
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: discourse
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
